commands.label: controls-create
argv:
import os,subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
assert os.getuid()==501 and os.getgid()==20
assert Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text().strip()=='536870912'
assert Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.swap.max').read_text().strip()=='0'
p=Path('/owned');(p/'tmp').mkdir(mode=0o700)
env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','CORTEX_PUBLIC_DUMMY_TMP':'/owned/tmp','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
for label,path,out in [('source','/code/attempt5/source-controls.py',None),('common','/code/coordinate-source/task03-attempt5-run-common-controls.py','/owned/common'),('descendant','/code/coordinate-source/owned-descendant-controls.py','/owned/descendant')]:
 e=dict(env)
 if out:e['CORTEX_COORDINATOR_TEST_OUT']=out
 r=subprocess.run(['/usr/local/bin/python3.12','-B',path],env=e,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
 for suffix,data in [('stdout',r.stdout),('stderr',r.stderr)]:
  fd=os.open(p/(label+'.'+suffix),os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600);os.write(fd,data);os.fsync(fd);os.close(fd)
 print(json.dumps({'label':label,'exitCode':r.returncode,'result':json.loads(r.stdout) if r.returncode==0 else None}),flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==0,label
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','publicAcquisition':46,'conservedCoordinator':9,'invalidBounds':4,'actualDescendantVariants':2,'unknownOwnership':1,'realCredentialReads':0,'services':0}))
